rongmei.title: He! zaeng swni mundui rim gaimei

lines: 1. He! zaeng swni mundui rim gaymei ramc khou,
Zian mei ta tam khang, na guang pu the,
Chunsi zaeng si mikdui luang kei lou lana,
He! Ravguangc ntam datni mak ge.
Asei ntam mei nzian mei mik dui luang ,
Asei tingmik thanc pat dat ro;
Lung zingc mei tigaan no, He! Ravguangc ,
Zian mei ta zaeng huayna kap e salam.
2. Chana le tao hei aniw tamv kanc dikho,
Tat nymei luang but, ta zau lana;
Phang zau lo mikdui rauna tam kanmei ta,
He Ravguangc akum na tat ni cho.
3. Gaichui mei tingthan neiriu kum na zian mei;
He zianc mei n-tam khang sa-guang the
Patlou the zian mei ban sin kariu lou na
He Ravguangc tattuanc kan the zian mei.
4. Tingkao thu Ravguangc zanc khou khatna suni.
Kum sini zaeng simei rui gum liam;
Ai kapma bampui dita ningdat lak khe.
Aban zat heirui ham guang e salam.
